title: The Baywalk
physical_identity: Outdoor, dark, infinite concrete bay walk beside a sea, with broken street lights and a lower unfinished dirt path.
scale_topology: Infinitely long segmented strip: Upper Area bay walk and Lower Area dirt path, joined by stairs ~100 m apart, sea alongside.
anomalies: Painless Death calm effect from sea breeze
sea with four characteristics: Normal, Portal, Low-Tide, Ocean
lighting_sound: Mostly dark; many street lights dead; stair lamps work; sea breeze; no other sound stated.

entities.name: Smilers
entities.behavior: Hordes in Upper Area, drawn to light, absent from Lower Area

entities.name: The Brave
entities.behavior: Human group of ~10, friendly traders, hidden in Lower Area

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Smilers (Upper Area only)
hazards: no barriers at Lower Area edge

entrances.method: drown and arrive in The Sea
entrances.quote: Drowning in any level that has a sea or an ocean may bring you to Level 60

exits.method: jump into Sea in Portal characteristic
exits.quote: you have a chance of being sent to Level 7

signature_mechanic: A creeping calm from the sea breeze kills the anxious unless snapped out of it, while the adjacent sea cycles through four states.
verticality: Two tiers (upper bay walk over lower dirt path) connected by safe stairs; ocean state ~3,740 m deep.
do_not: treat Level 61 sleep exit as confirmed
conflicts_notes: Intro says 61st level; link list contains /level-59 with no visible use. Painless Death 'lasts forever' yet is stoppable.

key_quotes.quote: infinitely long, newly constructed, and "well-kept" concrete pathway next to a bay
no barriers to protect anyone from falling into "The Sea"
The main cause of death in Level 60 is the "Painless Death".
